area: Functionality and security: the remaining high-value resources read and scored (zscaler_full_checks B.17, FW.10, THR.12, GOV.9, ZPA.22-24, HLT.5-6; zscaler_genai_checks AIG.7), their scope and channel gating, metadata-only reads of key-holding lists, sample tenant and snapshot reads
title: Ten new scored checks checked against the installed SDK 1.11.3, the Scope rule, the Endpoint DLP channel, secret handling and unknown-not-pass, offline on the sample tenant

checks.what: Every path the new checks read is the one the installed SDK 1.11.3 method sends (zia endpoint_dlp_resource_groups, dlp_endpoint_resource, partner_integrations, traffic_capture, time_intervals; zpa zia_customer_config, app_connector_schedule, service_edge_schedule, customer_version_profile, user_portal_aup, user_portal_link; aiguard llm_provider_credentials), and every field of the new sample answers is one the SDK model reads (the provider credential's id and creation time are marked assumed)

Each new check runs only under its Scope page key (ZIA platform, ZPA, DLP, AI Guard); the ZPA and AI Guard reads are refused by the run's client with no request when the key is unticked; the Endpoint DLP resource reads belong to the Endpoint DLP channel and are refused without it; an assessment with nothing ticked is a 400 before any client is built

LLM provider credentials and partner integrations are kept as metadata the moment they are read, in the raw assessment client and the SDK client, before caching; the check strips again; a snapshot scrubs apiCredentials; a canary key never reaches a result, a cache, a log or a snapshot
The ZPA ZIA cloud configuration (ZIA password, API key, sandbox token) is never read or captured: ZPA.22 reads only the yes/no availability answer

A missing field, an unreadable list or an unknown answer is INFO with the reason, never a pass: a resource group whose channel was not read, a schedule without enabled, an unresolvable version profile, a credential without dates, a rule or partner without a state
Check ids are unique across every registry the server runs; every new check is permission-guarded (a 403 is Not permitted, never judged)
Mutation proof: removing the metadata filter from the raw client and the SDK client makes both metadata tests fail

Six objects read until now only by backup and Terraform are scored (FW.11 DNS application groups, FW.12 workload groups, CA.6 HTTP header profiles, ZPA.25 client-to-client IP ranges, ZPA.26 isolation certificates, ZTW.9 connector IP groups): each path is the installed SDK's, each sample field is in the SDK model, each read is under its Scope key and in snapshots, and a missing or unreadable field is unknown, never a pass

findings.title: The ZPA ZIA cloud configuration answer (zpa/zia_customer_config.py get_zia_cloud_service_config) holds the ZIA password, API key and sandbox token; reading it to check the link would put secrets in the run
findings.fix: ZPA.22 reads only check_zia_cloud_config (GET /config/isZiaCloudConfigAvailable, a yes/no answer); a test asserts the configuration path is never read or captured

findings.title: The live assessment client would have cached the AI Guard provider credentials answer whole, apiCredentials included
findings.fix: dlp_assessment_full_auto.metadata_only reduces the answer to names, types and dates in Client.get and SdkClient._raw_get before it is cached

findings.title: Check 5.2 still says Endpoint DLP resources are not listed by the ZIA API; the SDK 1.11.3 lists them per channel, now read by B.17
findings.fix: left unchanged (outside this slice); B.17 reads and scores the resources

findings.title: GOV.9 passed ("No traffic capture rule") on a 200 answer that was not a list of rules ({}, text, a number, true, a list of non-rules)
findings.fix: Only a real empty list (bare or in the list envelope) means no capture rule; any other shape, and an unreadable entry beside disabled rules, is unknown with the reason

findings.title: THR.12 dropped partner integrations with no disabled field from a pass without saying so
findings.fix: The result counts and names the partners with no enabled state as unknown, in a pass and in a finding; all of them missing is unknown

findings.title: HLT.6 passed when ZPA listed no Default profile, and read a version field the SDK's CustomerVersionProfile model does not have (versions are per component in versionDetails), so a custom profile always passed
findings.fix: No Default profile, or a profile with no App Connector version in versionDetails, is unknown with the reason; the sample profiles carry versions so the comparison runs offline (the role name ASSISTANT is assumed)

findings.title: The test canary key was written whole in the test source, so the tracked-file credential scan (test_secret_canaries) failed
findings.fix: The canary is built from two parts at run time

findings.title: An isolation certificate's pem field could carry a private key pasted with the certificate, and a snapshot would have kept it
findings.fix: offline_tenant.scrub masks any text value holding a PRIVATE KEY block; ZPA.26 reads only the certificate's end of validity and shows nothing of the PEM
